title: Unfold a folding music stand's desk without disturbing the ukulele lying in its open case in front of it
instruction: Unfold the music stand's desk: swing out both folded ledges until the side braces are straight, keep the stand upright, then let go.
context: At school rehearsals and music lessons, players open folding stands to hold their sheet music. Both ledges have to swing out until the braces straighten while the light stand stays upright beside the instrument case.
setup: A black steel folding music stand (K&M 10065 type, 1.55 kg) stands on the floor in front of the arms on its tripod (legs 69 cm across), centred at x 0.58, y 0.00 m, with its desk 48.5 x 24 cm facing the arms, tilted back 20 deg, its 4.2 cm ledge at 0.80 m above the floor. Each half of the desk is a linkage of steel strips on real pivots: a ledge arm hinged at the bottom of the centre spine, a top bar hinged at its top, an outer upright between them, and a diagonal brace in two halves with a knee in the middle. Start: the desk fully folded for carrying, both halves collapsed against the centre spine (ledges up, diagonal braces bent at their knees); the stand's height and tilt are already set and locked. Between the arms and the stand: a small wooden side table (oak top 26 x 70 x 2.2 cm at 0.60 m, 7 cm apron, four tapered square legs), centred at x 0.43, y 0.00 m, its far edge 1.7 cm short of the stand's centre. On it, at the arm-side edge, the base of a black soprano ukulele hardshell case shaped on the ukulele's outline (58 x 22 cm outside: 22 cm at the lower bout, 17.6 cm at the waist, 18.5 cm at the upper bout, 9.6 cm along the neck, 16.2 cm at the head; 75 mm deep; blue plush lining, padded neck rest; 1.0 kg empty), long axis along y, centred at x 0.41, y 0.00 m; its lid is open past 180 deg and hangs down over the table's arm-side edge. In the case, face up, body end toward -y: a soprano ukulele (wood, 53 cm long, body 24 x 17 x 6 cm, 0.40 kg), a separate rigid body with its own colliders resting in the lining. Arms parked.
scoring: A half of the desk counts as deployed when its ledge is within 3 deg of its open stop, its outer upright within 3 deg of vertical, and both halves of its diagonal brace within 3 deg of straight. 1.0: both halves deployed; 0.5: one; 0 otherwise. Any credit also needs the stand upright within 3 deg and within 3 cm of its start, on every sample of the last 1 s, every sampled fingertip point at least 8 cm from the sampled points of the open desk outline and the stand tube, and the stand and both ledges still (under 1 mm, under 0.5 deg). Latched 0 if the stand tips more than 10 deg or slides more than 5 cm, or the ukulele or its case moves more than 5 mm or turns more than 3 deg from its settled pose (taken at 2 s), at any time; if the hands cannot be located, no credit.
reset_notes: Fold both halves of the desk back against the spine (diagonal braces bent), leave the height and tilt locked, put the tripod back on its floor marks, and put the side table, the open case (lid hanging) and the ukulele in it back on their marks.
fidelity: Rigid steel strips on hinge joints closed with loop joints, pivots scaled to the published desk size; the braces have no over-centre detent. Pin friction, damping and masses are estimates. The ukulele is a separate rigid body resting in the case, with convex colliders for its two bouts, neck and headstock; strings, tuners and bridge are visual only. The case, its hanging lid and the table collide as convex pieces. The stand is loose on the floor.
